actions.reason: K2_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity: a coherent transcriptomic program with strong up-enrichment of oxidative phosphorylation (NES 2.29, FDR q=0.001) plus coordinated interferon, antigen-presentation, inflammatory, and proliferative axes (ER:0155eb9d7205:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e9f462ede3). The required terminal structural report shows the set screens at candidate_k=1 with a dominant leading eigengap (~0.982) and no feasible k>=2 solution with strong native-view separation (k=2 normalized cut ~0.992, small positive silhouettes 0.048-0.109), so no meaningful internal subdivision is supported and no split is warranted (ER:0155eb9d7205:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:set:e9f462ede3). Retention is supported as the current independent unit; the weak pair boundary with K2_C0002 is a triage observation and merge is not permitted in this workflow.

K2_C0002 has an interpretable biological identity: a coherent transcriptomic program that is the mirror image of K2_C0001, with strong down-enrichment of oxidative phosphorylation (NES -2.29, FDR q=0.001) and coordinated down-enrichment of interferon, antigen-presentation, inflammatory, and proliferative axes (ER:0155eb9d7205:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:eba7fa9609). The required terminal structural report shows the set screens at candidate_k=1 with a dominant leading eigengap (~0.988) and no feasible k>=2 solution with strong native-view separation (k=2 normalized cut ~0.992, CT silhouette near zero), so no meaningful internal subdivision is supported and no split is warranted (ER:0155eb9d7205:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:set:eba7fa9609). Retention is supported as the current independent unit; the weak pair boundary with K2_C0001 is a triage observation and merge is not permitted in this workflow.
